description:
Produce the committed benchmark receipts on suitable uncontended hosts: no statistically measurable throughput regression against the pinned pre-cutover baseline, deterministic results across supported worker counts, tested scalar fallback for AVX2 dispatch, and the comparison rows against the survey's selected external baselines.

## Background

The regression comparison uses the pre-cutover baseline receipt pinned by its dedicated issue, under the evidence protocol's statistical rule. The comparison against the strongest external baseline is the epic's aspirational target; the receipts report it either way.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Committed receipts demonstrate non-regression versus the pinned pre-cutover baseline under the protocol's one-sided bound, determinism across worker counts, and scalar-fallback coverage, with host, seed, revision, and toolchain recorded.
- [hard] REQ-02: Receipts include the external-baseline comparison rows for both workloads with the survey's protocol, reporting the aspirational outcome explicitly.
title: Committed performance receipts: non-regression, determinism, SOTA comparison
